clarification.en: Are you looking for vehicles to rent, rental prices, or the status of unavailable listings?
clarification.fil: Naghahanap ka ba ng sasakyang marerentahan, presyo ng renta, o status ng unavailable listings?
clarification.taglish: Vehicles to rent, rental prices, or unavailable listing status ba ang gusto mong malaman?

clarification.en: Do you want to make a booking, check your own booking status, or cancel a booking?
clarification.fil: Gusto mo bang mag-book, tingnan ang sarili mong booking status, o magkansela ng booking?
clarification.taglish: Do you want to book, check your own booking status, or cancel a booking?

clarification.en: Are you asking about payment methods, the 30% down payment, or remaining-balance rules?
clarification.fil: Payment methods, 30% down payment, o mga tuntunin sa natitirang balanse ba ang tinatanong mo?
clarification.taglish: Payment methods, 30% down payment, or remaining-balance rules ba ang tanong mo?

clarification.en: Do you need rental requirements, help with a rejected verification, or information about document security?
clarification.fil: Kailangan mo ba ng rental requirements, tulong sa rejected verification, o impormasyon sa seguridad ng dokumento?
clarification.taglish: Rental requirements, rejected verification help, or document security ba ang tanong mo?

clarification.en: Are you having trouble signing in or resetting your password? Describe what happens so I can point you to the right account step.
clarification.fil: May problema ba sa pag-sign in o pag-reset ng password? Sabihin kung ano ang nangyayari para maituro ko ang tamang hakbang.
clarification.taglish: Sign-in or password reset problem ba? Tell me what happens so I can point you to the right account step.

clarification.en: Are you asking about reviews, notifications, or messaging an owner?
clarification.fil: Reviews, notifications, o pag-message sa owner ba ang tinatanong mo?
clarification.taglish: Reviews, notifications, or messaging an owner ba ang tanong mo?

clarification.en: Do you need help listing your vehicle, managing booking requests, or viewing owner earnings?
clarification.fil: Kailangan mo ba ng tulong sa pag-list ng sasakyan, booking requests, o pagtingin sa owner earnings?
clarification.taglish: Listing a vehicle, managing booking requests, or viewing owner earnings ba ang kailangan mo?

clarification.en: Would you like to know what I can help with, who I am, or which languages I support?
clarification.fil: Gusto mo bang malaman ang maitutulong ko, kung sino ako, o ang mga wikang suportado ko?
clarification.taglish: Do you want to know what I can help with, who I am, or which languages I support?
